episodes.title: Welcome to the Jungle
episodes.summary: The challenge is to create a new human/animal hybrid based from 3 exotic animals that are brought into lab.

episodes.title: Naked Ambition
episodes.summary: A full-body makeup challenge for the contestants.

episodes.title: Out of This World
episodes.summary: Makeup artist Michael Westmore meets the contestants at Vasquez Rocks in Southern California, where episodes of "Star Trek" were shot, and the competitors learn that they must create an alien for a newly discovered world

episodes.title: Bad to the Bone
episodes.summary: "Friday the 13th" director Sean Cunningham serves as a guest judge for a challenge that has the contestants creating an original horror-movie villain along with an accompanying movie poster, title and tagline.

episodes.title: Switched and Hitched
episodes.summary: In teams of two, the contestants turn brides into grooms and grooms into brides.

episodes.title: The Dancing Dead
episodes.summary: Zombies take over as the seven remaining special effects artists must create an original zombie to avoid the dreaded double elimination on "Dancing Dead".

episodes.title: Family Plot
episodes.summary: The five remaining contestants must disguise themselves to fool their own family members at a Los Angeles wig shop.

episodes.title: Twisted Tales
episodes.summary: The last challenge has the three remaining contestants creating fairy-tale characters derived from "The Three Little Pigs," "Little Red Riding Hood" and "Hansel and Gretel" for a cocktail-party setting in the first-season finale.

episodes.title: Return to Oz
episodes.summary: Fourteen aspiring makeup artists face off in the Season 2 premiere, which has them re-imagining characters from "The Wonderful Wizard of Oz".

episodes.title: Water World
episodes.summary: The Aquarium of the Pacific in Long Beach is visited ahead of a challenge in which the contestants must make waterproof creature makeup.

episodes.title: Rock Your Body
episodes.summary: A nude body painting challenge unfolds as the contestants try to make an album cover for hip-hop star (and guest judge) Asher Roth.

episodes.title: Night Terrors
episodes.summary: A late-night call summons the contestants to an abandoned hospital in Los Angeles. When they arrive they each get to choose an obscure phobia to use as the basis for creating a monster.

episodes.title: Dangerous Beauty
episodes.summary: The team competes in a trauma wound foundation contest then return to the lab, which has been transformed into a jungle, and discover they'll be studying live animals to create something beautiful but deadly.

episodes.title: Triple Threat
episodes.summary: For the foundation challenge, the contestants must debeautify attractive models,.make triplets appear to be at different stages of their elderly lives.

episodes.title: Alien Interpreters
episodes.summary: This week, aliens are the artists' focus and guest judge Star Trek Next Generation's LeVar Burton helps out.

episodes.title: Burtonesque
episodes.summary: Creating a new character from an ordinary occupation for a Tim Burton film.

episodes.title: Dinoplasty
episodes.summary: The five remaining contestants participate in a double-elimination event to create a human-dinosaur hybrid to determine which of them will go to the finale.

episodes.title: The Ultimate Spotlight Challenge
episodes.summary: The finalists must each create three original characters from a specific movie genre who will perform a choreographed-dance routine at the Alex Theatre in Glendale, CA.

episodes.title: A Force to Be Reckoned With
episodes.summary: Sean Astin greets the contestants, who are challenged to create original aliens for the "Star Wars" cantina scene in the Season 3 opener.

episodes.title: Pirate Treasure
episodes.summary: The contestants must create an original pirate character "who has become one with the sea".

episodes.title: Year of the Dragon
episodes.summary: The Chinese New Year is the theme as the contestants create dragon makeup for performers doing an acrobatic dance routine.

episodes.title: Alice in Zombieland
episodes.summary: The contestants create zombie makeup for characters from "Alice's Adventures in Wonderland." Director Paul W.S. Anderson serves as a guest judge.

episodes.title: Supermobile
episodes.summary: The contestants create makeup for superheroes and their sidekicks after getting inspiration from some astonishing vehicles. Kevin Smith is a guest judge.

episodes.title: Dishonorable Proportions
episodes.summary: The artists take inspiration from the video game Dishonored when creating characters with exaggerated features for the challenge.

episodes.title: Monster Twist
episodes.summary: The competing artists are tasked with creating original movie monsters based on sketches done by children. And a new twist changes everything

episodes.title: Who's the New Who?
episodes.summary: The competing artists use makeup to create looks inspired by Dr. Seuss' "Sleep Book," which is celebrating its 50th anniversary.

episodes.title: Junkyard Cyborg
episodes.summary: Material from a junkyard must be used in a cyborg challenge.

episodes.title: Scene of the Crime
episodes.summary: The NBC series "Grimm" inspires the makeup created by the competing artists.

episodes.title: Immortal Enemies
episodes.summary: The remaining three artists are tasked with creating Halloween-themed characters, which they then must have perform in a choreographed stunt show.

episodes.title: Live Finale
episodes.summary: Viewers choose the Season 3 winner, who will be announced during the finale in Los Angeles. Also: The eliminated artists reunite.

episodes.title: Make It Reign
episodes.summary: The artists create goblin kings and are judged by actor John Rhys-Davies.

episodes.title: Heroic Proportions
episodes.summary: The artists compete for the chance to have their design featured in a DC Comic book; the contestants must create an original superhero.

episodes.title: When Hell Freezes Over
episodes.summary: Contestants must create a sinister demon.

episodes.title: Eye Candy
episodes.summary: The contestants must create a creature using candy that is found throughout the lab.

episodes.title: Two Heads Are Better Than One
episodes.summary: The artists try to create a larger-than-life giant character based on an ancient fable.

episodes.title: Bugging Out
episodes.summary: The contestants will choose images to be used for a creepy-crawly bug-themed challenge.

episodes.title: Howl at the Moon
episodes.summary: The contestants must create planet-inspired alien werewolves.

episodes.title: It's Better in the Dark
episodes.summary: The artists must create a never-before-seen creature that glows in the dark.

episodes.title: Mummy Mayhem
episodes.summary: The artists must create an Egyptian god mummy inspired by the Evil Dead franchise.

episodes.title: Alien Apocalypse
episodes.summary: The artists visit the set of the new Syfy series "Defiance" to inspire original alien creations.

episodes.title: Living the Dream
episodes.summary: The three finalists must create a waterproof makeup for the show "Le Reve: The Dream" at the Wynn Hotel in Las Vegas.

episodes.title: Going for Gold
episodes.summary: Eight newcomers take on eight former contestants as each team creates a series of hyper-stylized fantasy characters.

episodes.title: Future Frankenstein
episodes.summary: The contestants must make a far-future monster.

episodes.title: Gettin' Goosed
episodes.summary: A mini-challenge inspired by the demon in "Insidious;" the contestants create a modern twist to a Mother Goose character.

episodes.title: Subterranean Terror
episodes.summary: Artists explore tunnels in search of clues.

episodes.title: Mother Earth Goddess
episodes.summary: Artists use elements from an arboretum and their own mothers to create Mother Nature goddesses.

episodes.title: Trick or Treat
episodes.summary: The artists are asked to incorporate a gag element to their designs.

episodes.title: Living Art
episodes.summary: The artists must create characters that could live within iconic art movements.

episodes.title: Cosmic Circus
episodes.summary: Artists are faced with creating dark and sexy alien circus characters for an out-of-this-world performance.

episodes.title: Mortal Sins
episodes.summary: The artists learn they must each create a character that embodies one of the seven deadly sins.

episodes.title: The Laughing Dead
episodes.summary: Arriving at the famous Laugh Factory comedy club, the artists are tasked with creating an original ghost character that is funny and scary.

episodes.title: Dark Magic
episodes.summary: At Kenneth Hahn Park, the artists are asked to choose magical Norse runes to inspire a dark elf warrior character.

episodes.title: Flights of Fantasy
episodes.summary: The contestants create original human-bird hybrids for the penultimate Spotlight Challenge.

episodes.title: Swan Song
episodes.summary: The artists must create a sorcerer and swan for a special performance of "Swan Lake" by the Los Angeles Ballet.

episodes.title: Sexy Beasts
episodes.summary: Season 6 begins with 15 contestants taking on the task of creating beasts to be paired with beauties.

episodes.title: Cosmic Conspiracy
episodes.summary: The challenge is to create out-of-this-world alien creatures that are afflicted with interplanetary ailments.

episodes.title: Dragon's Breath
episodes.summary: Dragon makeups are created by the 13 remaining artists for the season's first individual Spotlight Challenge.

episodes.title: Guitar Gods
episodes.summary: The artists work in teams to create rockers who are literally at one with their electric guitars.

episodes.title: In the Shadows
episodes.summary: The contestants create monsters based on silhouettes given to them by the producers.

episodes.title: Cryptic Creatures
episodes.summary: Today the artists take inspiration from a swamp and make cryptids.

episodes.title: Open Sesame
episodes.summary: The remaining contestants have to create a wizard inspired look with wands on hand to provide further inspiration.

episodes.title: Ego Trip Abroad
episodes.summary: The lucky contestants arrive in Tokyo and dive into the beauty, excitement, and magic of the city in places like the hectic Shibuya district, sensual fish markets, and serene city gardens. In one of these, Rikugien Garden, they meet their Foundation Challenge, as well as one of the makeup industry's heroes, Kazuhiro Tsuji.

episodes.title: Mad Science
episodes.summary: When the contestants walk into the lab, it's completely transformed into a different kind of lab, one that a mad scientist might use to transform a human guinea pig into a grotesque monster. McKenzie allows them to choose an antique medical (torture) device to best create their "experiment", from a trephine to an embalming pump.

episodes.title: What a Dahl
episodes.summary: To help celebrate the 50th anniversary of the film Charlie and the Chocolate Factory, the artists will be creating their very own visions of Roald Dahl creatures that have never before been seen onscreen: Hornswogglers, Snozzwangers, Vermicious Knids, and Whangdoodles - all predators of the dear, sweet, oompa-loompa. Filmmaker (and daughter of Roald Dahl) Lucy Dahl gives the artists some key thoughts on how to make a creature that would survive and thrive in her father's world: Make them whimsical, scary, and the extreme expression of whatever characteristic they embody. She'll be back to see their final creations at the reveal stage!

episodes.title: Freaks of Nature
episodes.summary: The artists must create original mutants.

episodes.title: Industrial Revolution
episodes.summary: Los Angeles Union Station inspires the artists before they create futuristic robots tailored to specific professions.

episodes.title: Bloodsuckers
episodes.summary: Who's the best monster in the world? The vampire, of course! And that's exactly who the artists get to make this week. And since this is Face Off, it's not going to be easy: each artist chooses, at random, the name of a vampiric character from another culture. They must create their interpretation of these worldwide myths, as well as add an extra killing feature not usually associated with vampires.

episodes.title: Cry Wolf
episodes.summary: The four remaining artists compete for a spot in the finale by creating werewolf rivals for their vampire characters.

episodes.title: Heavenly Bodies
episodes.summary: The remaining contestants have to create two dancing aliens who are able to perform without breaking.

episodes.title: Life and Death
episodes.summary: It's a whole new world with this season of Face Off! With the theme of Life and Death, contestants won't just be eliminated - they'll be killed! Just kidding.

episodes.title: American Gangster
episodes.summary: After their first night in the gorgeous house as real contestants (so exciting, squeeel!) the artists meet McKenzie in New York. Just teasing, not New York, New York (is there an echo in here?), but New York Street at Universal Studios.

episodes.title: Ancient Aliens
episodes.summary: Have you ever heard the phrase, "Happier than a makeup artist during alien week"? Neither have we, but once we see the contestants' faces after Glenn and McKenzie tell them they'll be working solo to build an alien, we just might coin the phrase.

episodes.title: Twisted Trees
episodes.summary: Guess what? We have a Foundation Challenge today, hooray! The contestants walk into the lab to see an array of models striking their very best "save the world" poses. McKenzie tells them they'll be basing an entire superhero, backstory and everything, on the costume that their model is wearing.

episodes.title: Animal Attraction
episodes.summary: McKenzie takes the artists to a place where their inner kids can come out and play: the Wildlife Learning Center.

episodes.title: Wizard of Wonderland
episodes.summary: Somewhere over Sony Pictures Studios towers a giant sculpture of a rainbow, hearkening back to that groundbreaking film, The Wizard of Oz. McKenzie stands underneath the three-story rainbow amid a jumble of teacups and teapots, so the contestants know that whatever's ahead is going to be whimsical with a vengeance.

episodes.title: Judge Match
episodes.summary: The judges pair up with two team members, a former all-star contestant and former champion, to create a pair of living chess pieces in a special competition for charity.

episodes.title: Killer Instinct
episodes.summary: McKenzie summons the contestants to the lab where they encounter a heavy mist and a gothic mirror. She directs them to speak the name of Bloody Mary three times while looking into it.

episodes.title: Serpent Soldiers
episodes.summary: Working for the G.I. Joe franchise, the artists use their talents to create snake-inspired super soldiers.

episodes.title: Scared Silly
episodes.summary: The artists turn their worst childhood fears into terrifying evil clowns who will perform a nightmarish circus routine.

episodes.title: Teacher's Pets
episodes.summary: It's back to high school for the remaining artists as they are tasked with creating fun mythical fantasy characters based on classic high school stereotypes.

episodes.title: Off with Their Heads
episodes.summary: The artists are faced with the challenge of creating a Greek God and also the severed head of a beast they have slain.

episodes.title: Beautiful Disaster
episodes.summary: With the semifinals around the corner, the artists must take inspiration from disaster scenarios and craft elemental fairies born from each one.

episodes.title: Creature Carnage
episodes.summary: The four semifinalists conquer giant city-crushing monstrosities in order to crush their way straight into the finale.

episodes.title: One Knight Only
episodes.summary: The season of life and death concludes as the artists tackle the fantastical world of knights in an effort to win the crown.

episodes.title: Return of the Champions
episodes.summary: Fifteen new artists – coached by three returning champions - join forces to spawn a legion of alien creatures.

episodes.title: Monkey Business
episodes.summary: The alien creations from the season premiere have crash-landed on the Planet of the Apes, and the artists must crown its King Primate.

episodes.title: Let the Games Begin
episodes.summary: The Hunger Games star Josh Hutcherson guest judges a creature-filled challenge.

episodes.title: Royal Flush
episodes.summary: Inspired by Tim Burton's Alice in Wonderland, the artists conceive a Burton-esque character based on a face card from a classic deck of playing cards.

episodes.title: Sounding Off
episodes.summary: The artists compose a unique character inspired by the original sounds of two-time Oscar nominee Erik Aadahl (Godzilla, World War Z).

episodes.title: Troll Bridge
episodes.summary: The artists shape their own unique Troll creature based on the architecture, geography and culture of a famous bridge.

episodes.title: Queen Bees
episodes.summary: The artists devise their own queen insect and companion character in this daunting team body-painting challenge. Plus – the return of Lois Burwell!

episodes.title: Dressed to Kill
episodes.summary: The artists select a stunning avant-garde outfit as inspiration for their own stylish horror villain.

episodes.title: Miss Intergalactic
episodes.summary: Inspired by the sexy aliens of Avatar and Species, the artists select a sash with the name of a real galaxy and fashion its beauty queen.

episodes.title: Super Selfies
episodes.summary: The artists shape their own personal superhero or villain alter-egos, using themselves as their own models!

episodes.title: Imaginary Friends
episodes.summary: The artists bring a whimsical creature to life based on a child's description of their imaginary companion.

episodes.title: Deadly Dolls
episodes.summary: The artists select from several different dolls from Bob Baker's famous Marionette Theater to concoct the next Chucky or Annabelle.

episodes.title: Full Steam Ahead
episodes.summary: The final four select a classic Wild West archetype and reimagine it in steampunk cyborg form.

episodes.title: The Dream Team
episodes.summary: The three finalists must create characters that could star in a film from one of three genres: Sci-Fi, Fantasy or Post-Apocalyptic.

episodes.title: Intergalactic Zoo
episodes.summary: 16 artists arrive and things quickly turn into an intergalactic zoo for which they must create alien/animal hybrids.

episodes.title: Siren Song
episodes.summary: The artists created a unique Siren creature from Greek mythology using a marine animal as inspiration.

episodes.title: Surprise of the Century
episodes.summary: The 100th episode of Face Off had the artists creating macabre makeups for engaged couples ... and then McKenzie officiated their group wedding!

episodes.title: Frightful Fiction
episodes.summary: The artists must create a mashup character from famous works of genre literature.

episodes.title: The Gatekeepers
episodes.summary: The artists paired up to create the gatekeeper to an alternate dimension ... and the creature he or she guards.

episodes.title: Extraterrestrial Enterprise
episodes.summary: The artists boldly go where Face Off has never gone before with a Star Trek-inspired challenge.

episodes.title: All That Glitters
episodes.summary: The artists turn male models into Shakespearean females.

episodes.title: The Gauntlet
episodes.summary: In a Face Off first, the artists must compete in three intense rounds of Foundation Challenges.

episodes.title: Judgment Day
episodes.summary: The artists must create their own versions of the Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse.

episodes.title: Freak Show
episodes.summary: The artists must create their very own freak show character inspired by a promotional poster.

episodes.title: Beyond the Expanse
episodes.summary: Inspired by Syfy's The Expanse, the artists must create a character that represents the next stage in human evolution.

episodes.title: Death Becomes Them
episodes.summary: Inspired by The Munsters and The Addams Family, the artists create a monster based on a stereotypical family archetype.

episodes.title: Movie Magic (1)
episodes.summary: The three finalists discover they'll be working with a Hollywood director to create three stunning short films on location.

episodes.title: Movie Magic (2)
episodes.summary: Season 9 Finale! The finalists work on their short film shoots with acclaimed director and creature designer Patrick Tatopoulos.

episodes.title: Wanted Dead or Alive
episodes.summary: Inspired by a wanted poster and spaceship, the artists must create their own intergalactic bounty hunter.

episodes.title: Child's Play
episodes.summary: Inspired by Pee-wee's Playhouse, the artists must bring an everyday toy to life.

episodes.title: Lost Languages
episodes.summary: Inspired by a custom language (created just for Face Off), the artists must create the long-lost species it belongs to.

episodes.title: Covert Characters
episodes.summary: Inspired by the upcoming series, Hunters, the artists must create the perfect human disguise.

episodes.title: Foreign Bodies
episodes.summary: The artists must concoct creatures inspired by real human parasites … but there's a twist.

episodes.title: Death's Doorstep
episodes.summary: The artists must take a comedic obituary and create an eccentric character inspired by it.

episodes.title: The Gauntlet II
episodes.summary: The Gauntlet returns. Included: The eight remaining artists compete in a series of three challenges, with the winners of the first two getting a night on the town, while the artist in the third round who's named bottom look goes home.

episodes.title: Smoke and Mirrors
episodes.summary: Inspired by fairy tales, the artists must transform beautiful sorceresses into their ancient, evil selves revealed in a magic mirror.

episodes.title: Bottled Up
episodes.summary: The artists must select exotic vessels and create the genie that inhabits it.

episodes.title: Keep One Eye Open
episodes.summary: The artists must create their own Cyclops monster, straight out of Greek mythology.

episodes.title: The Art of Warcraft
episodes.summary: The artists must choose World of Warcraft's most memorable creatures and bring them to life!

episodes.title: Skull Island: Reign of Kong
episodes.summary: Inspired by the new attraction at Universal Orlando Resort, the artists must create an indigenous species that would inhabit King Kong's Skull Island.

episodes.title: Sinister Showdown (1)
episodes.summary: The artists must create two characters that would be part of a horror film: one demonic character and one possessed character. Three different directors with different scripts of the film named "Hell Hole" will work with each artist. Eliminated contestants will also aid the finalists during the challenge.

episodes.title: Sinister Showdown (2)
episodes.summary: The three finalists have to create short horror films before the champion is crowned.

episodes.title: Abstract Aliens
episodes.summary: In the season premiere, eight teams of returning All Star artists create unique alien creatures while incorporating green screen technology for the first time in Face Off history.

episodes.title: The Devil Is in the Details
episodes.summary: The epic All-Star season continues as the teams work to create angel and devil characters in the first elimination challenge of the season.

episodes.title: Monster High
episodes.summary: The artists arrive at Mattel Headquarters where they learn they will be creating film ready versions of "Monster High" characters in this week's immunity challenge.

episodes.title: Snow Queens
episodes.summary: In the second elimination challenge of the season, the All-Star teams work to create beautiful snow queens inspired by a series of unique snowflakes.

episodes.title: Troubling Transformations
episodes.summary: The competition takes a monstrous turn as the All-Star teams must create two Jekyll and Hyde inspired makeups in this week's elimination challenge for legendary filmmaker and guest judge John Landis.

episodes.title: Wasteland Warriors
episodes.summary: The All-Stars create dystopian characters inspired by post-apocalyptic vehicles for the elimination challenge.

episodes.title: Puppet Masters
episodes.summary: The conclusion from last week's elimination challenge; the immunity challenge has the teams create magical marionette characters.

episodes.title: Odd Couples
episodes.summary: The five remaining All-Star teams create comedic fantasy duos in the elimination challenge.

episodes.title: Frightening Families
episodes.summary: The competition is turned on its head as the eight remaining all-stars are combined into a pair of super teams that must each create a frightening family of three mutated characters.

episodes.title: Cursed Covens
episodes.summary: The seven remaining artists, and their two super teams, each create a coven of cursed witches, and another all-star is eliminated from the competition.

episodes.title: Intergalactic Congress
episodes.summary: The remaining artists, competing individually, must create an alien delegate for an intergalactic congress.

episodes.title: Tiki Twist
episodes.summary: The final five must create a representation of a Hawaiian God or Goddess.

episodes.title: Gargoyle Guardians
episodes.summary: The last four create gargoyles inspired by different styles of architecture.

episodes.title: Battle of the Beasts
episodes.summary: The final three create animalistic kung-fu masters for an actual fight scene.

episodes.title: Pack Leaders
episodes.summary: In a first, the artists are divided into two make-up effects shop. First assignment: design a werewolf pack.

episodes.title: Hive Mind
episodes.summary: Inspired by hive-minded insects, the artists must create queen, worker and drone aliens.

episodes.title: Dream House
episodes.summary: Comedy meets drama in this Spotlight Challenge as the shops work to create families of whimsical characters based on unique fairytale houses.

episodes.title: Dante's Demons
episodes.summary: The artists must create a demon that would oversee a specific circle of Dante's version of Hell.

episodes.title: String Theory
episodes.summary: The artists must bring the four seasons to life for a dance to be choreographed by Travis Wall.

episodes.title: Possessed Possessions
episodes.summary: The artists create looks for the owners of possessed objects; Cheyenne Jackson guest judges.

episodes.title: Feral Fungi
episodes.summary: The six remaining artists create victims of a fungal virus that turns people into zombies.

episodes.title: Amusing Aliens
episodes.summary: It's the semi-finals as the artists create fun and friendly aliens for a surprise guest judge, movie makeup legend Rick Baker.

episodes.title: Journey Into Fear, Part 1
episodes.summary: The final three must create creatures for a haunted house conceptualized by series judge Glenn Hetrick.

episodes.title: Journey Into Fear, Part 2
episodes.summary: Twists abound for the final three's haunted house challenge. Who will be named winner of Face Off Season 12?.

episodes.title: Face Your Fears
episodes.summary: In the season premiere of Face Off, twelve of your favorite artists return to the competition with a twist: this time they're battling.

episodes.title: Moonlight Monsters
episodes.summary: In the first elimination challenge of the season, the artists battle it out as they create fun and lighthearted monsters inspired by real life day jobs.

episodes.title: Aztec Aliens
episodes.summary: It's another epic week of battles, as the artists create ancient aliens that could have been the inspiration for Aztec gods.

episodes.title: Haunted Hotel
episodes.summary: In this week's elimination challenge, the artists battle head-to-head as they create the quirky and ghostly staff of a haunted hotel.

episodes.title: Death Dealers
episodes.summary: Fortune favors the bold this week, as the artists and their battle partners create makeups based on actual tarot card readings.

episodes.title: Divine Dryads
episodes.summary: The artists battle it out as they create dryad protectors of real life forests in this week's elimination challenge, with two more artists heading home.

episodes.title: Maritime Monsters
episodes.summary: The competition tightens as the six remaining artists create original sea monsters in this week's battles, with the help of an industry expert in next week's elimination challenge on the line.

episodes.title: Immortals Interrupted
episodes.summary: It's the semifinals and the artists engage in an all out battle royale, as they create vampires based on real life bats with just three finale spots on the line.

episodes.title: Through the Looking Glass, Part 1
episodes.summary: It's part one of the finale, as the finalists learn that they will be creating characters for an original short film based on the book, "Through the Looking Glass and What Alice Found There."

episodes.title: Through the Looking Glass, Part 2
episodes.summary: It's part two of the Face Off: Battle Royale finale, as the artists and their teams create their short film, and one is crowned champion.
